# `armadad runtime`

<!-- Generated by `make docs` from the commands; do not edit. -->

[All commands](armadad.md)

runtime extracts the runtime pack this armadad carries (crun, the CNI plugins,
tini, armada-shim, armada-log, armada-dns, armada-node, and etcd) into the data
directory, verifies it, and exits; armada-agent (which armada-server wants)
starts it (armada-runtime.service). It does nothing on nodes that are not initialized yet.

A node still on containerd fails here: this release runs containers on the
supervisor runtime only (ADR 0046). Upgrade such a node through v0.1.0-alpha.44
first, or remove it and join it again.

```
armadad runtime [flags]
```

Examples:

```bash
sudo systemctl status armada-runtime   # started with armada-agent
sudo armadad runtime reset             # remove every container Armada runs here
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--bin-dir string` | use runtime binaries from this directory (builds without the bundle) |
| `--data-dir string` | Armada data directory (default `/var/lib/armada`) |

## `armadad runtime reset`

reset stops and removes all of Armada's containers on this node (those with
Armada's labels), the network sandboxes job queues are read from,
the node's resolver (armada-dns), and the cluster network's interface
and firewall rules.
Use it after `armada node delete`, with the agent (or server) stopped first,
or it starts its replicas again.

```
armadad runtime reset [flags]
```

Examples:

```bash
sudo systemctl stop armada-agent && sudo armadad runtime reset
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--data-dir string` | Armada data directory (default `/var/lib/armada`) |
